render.population_discriminator: R-38's population is the set of census rows whose RAW `canonical` field (NAMING_CENSUS_REPORT.r13.md's fenced json `rows` list, pre-render) contains a `{...}` placeholder token -- read from that json field directly, never from which column's RENDERED table bytes still carry `{`, since after this repair no column does (every column now escapes { to ( through the same render_cell).
render.third_column_argument: A new column is added by appending its name to COLUMNS and reading its raw value into the same row-build loop in build_table_bytes -- every cell, old or new, is passed to render_cell before it reaches the line, so a new column's braces render as parens automatically the first time it is written, with no second escaping branch to remember and nothing to re-derive.
